notes: The loader text timing is now one number for the whole round rather than a hold per word. The words share the round equally, so adding or removing one changes how long each is shown instead of quietly making the whole cycle longer.
Defaults to 4500ms - one complete pass per load at the current loader lifetime.
A very short round with several words is floored at 140ms per word, so a long list reads as words rather than a flicker.
